summary: Texas Forest Service Tower No. 8 near Maydelle, about 110 ft, built 1933 per NGS description, listed standing; 1946 patrol and 1952 staffing items; access not found.

facts.design: standard-type steel lookout tower, painted gray (NGS description)

staffing.status: forest patrolmen at the tower in 1946; J.A. Benge reported moving in to take over in January 1952; no later staffing reported

events.note: NGS description says the tower was built in 1933
June 1939 newspaper item calls it Tower No. 8, Maydelle State Forest; NGS description also says Tower No. 8
February 1946 item: Forest Patrolman Ray Sides at the Maydelle lookout tower; April 1946 item spells the name Roy Sides
January 1946 county fire reported and suppressed from the tower; the fire was caused by an incendiarist
March 1946: patrolman handled seven of the 34 county forest fires recorded that month
January 1952 Alto Herald item: J.A. Benge, formerly manager of the Alto tower, to take over the Maydelle fire tower

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The June 1939 item places the tower four miles southwest of Maydelle; the NGS description says four miles west. Story reports both and does not choose.
February and May 1946 items spell the patrolman's name Ray Sides; the April 1946 item spells it Roy Sides. Story reports the spelling variation without choosing.

sources.title: Mewshaw State Sawmill and Maydelle CCC Camp

notes_for_editor: Build year and height come from the NGS datasheet quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the datasheet's own PID and page were not fetched. The Forest Lookouts page gives no coordinates, so it is not confirmed that its tower is the Loc 2 site on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; the brief's Loc 2 identity is kept but unverified. The CCC camp link is inferred from the 1933 date and the camp's general work only; no source ties the camp to this tower's construction. Access is unknown. Used 1 WebSearch call and about 3 page reads plus the shared Texas index and FFLA list.
